metrics.name: mc_nova_tile_entities
metrics.help: Nova machines placed, per world. These are what consume tick time — a rising number explains a rising MSPT.

collector.name: nova
collector.text:
Nova — the machine census.

What its API allows, and what it doesn't: Nova's registries (`NovaBlockRegistry`, `NovaItemRegistry`) only do lookup by identifier — they enumerate nothing, so there's no "how many custom blocks exist" to pull from them. The `TileEntityManager`, though, enumerates. It's the only door, and it gives what actually matters: the number of machines placed, the ones consuming tick time.

Background mode, for good reason: `getTileEntities(World)` builds a list. On a server covered in machines, doing that on every scrape would make the exporter responsible for the lag it measures.
